title: ReviewState
description: What the researcher has reviewed in a project (ADR 0048), stored in the coordinator state directory. A mark records reading, not approval, and decides nothing.

project_id.title: ProjectId
project_id.description: Stable project identifier (lowercase slug). Never a path; paths live in the local registry.

items.description: Review marks by `kind:id` (a research record kind, or `task`).

^(.*)$.title: ReviewMark
^(.*)$.description: The researcher read one research record or task (ADR 0048).

digest.description: Hash of what the researcher read (title, status, description, read, evidence and the like; not links or tags). A different hash later shows the item as changed since review.

reviewed_at.title: Timestamp
reviewed_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with a `Z` suffix and optional fractional seconds.

by.title: ResearchActor
by.description: Who made a change: a human session, an agent token or the system. Work under a task links the task (`task:ID`).

note.description: The researcher's note on the item. Agents can read it; it grants nothing.
